items.Title: 2027 UR Early Career Program-Software Engr I
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
As a Software Engineer at Honeywell, you will launch your career by developing full-stack software, with an emphasis on software architecture, cloud application development, and artificial intelligence. You will learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to innovative projects across building automation, industrial automation, process automation, and process technology.

You will report to the Software R&D Manager and begin your first rotation at our Chongqing location. Through the three-rotation program, you will have opportunities to work at Honeywell locations across China, gaining broad exposure and accelerating your professional growth.

In this role, you will help develop and deploy scalable, cloud-based AI and backend solutions. You will gain valuable experience while strengthening Honeywell’s software capabilities and advancing technology in collaboration with global teams.

items.ExternalQualificationsStr:
YOU MUST HAVE

  • Recent graduate with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  • Basic understanding of full stack software development including backend and frontend technologies.
  • Familiarity or coursework experience with cloud application development and AI concepts.
  • Willingness to learn programming languages and frameworks relevant to backend, full stack, and cloud development.
  • Enthusiasm to work in a rotational program adapting to different teams and projects.

 

WE VALUE

  • Internship or project experience in software development, cloud platforms, or AI technologies.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Alibaba, AWS or Azure Cloud is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of AI frameworks and tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a global, cross-functional environment.

 

ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. Learn more

  • 支持大型行业展会、客户研讨会、工作坊的筹备与落地，并协助日常数字化营销的运营。

items.Title: 2027 UR Early Career Program-Application/Sys Sales Eng I
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
The Commercial Elite Program (CEP) is a structured leadership development initiative designed to cultivate the next generation of commercial leaders in the Process Technologies business. Through a planned multi-year rotational journey, participants will develop deep technical, marketing, operational, and commercial expertise while gaining exposure to customers, markets, products, and business operations.

Successful candidates will build a strong foundation in technical sales, gain insight into market strategy and execution, and ultimately transition into frontline sales roles with direct accountability for business growth and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) performance.

This program is designed for high-potential individuals who aspire to become future commercial leaders capable of driving profitable growth in a dynamic and competitive global industry.

items.InternalResponsibilitiesStr:
Primary Objectives & Job Responsibilities

  1. Provide onsite technical service support for Honeywell DCS system and related products under senior engineer’s guidance, covering chemical, petrochemical, as well as LNGC (LNG Carrier) vessel‑borne automation control systems.
  2. Assist in system troubleshooting, site implementation and commissioning support for both on‑shore plant sites and LNG carrier vessels.
  3. Deliver process control and application technical support for industrial process and marine LNG cargo control systems.
  4. Cooperate with service account manager to identify potential new business opportunities.
  5. Maintain positive customer relationship and drive customer satisfaction.
  6. Learn and provide support on network structure, cybersecurity and safe operation for both on‑shore plants and LNGC vessels.
  7. Gain hand‑on technical knowledge on VM, hardware and software for industrial and marine automation applications.
  8. Provide supporting tasks for SCADA system, including vessel‑mounted SCADA applications.
  9. Closely collaborate with Project Manager, Lead Engineer, Account Manager, Global TAC and cross‑functional team members.
  10. Participate in emergency/break‑fix service, annual contract service and service projects (new & migration projects), covering routine service tasks, engineering support, and customer training assistance for on‑shore and marine LNGC projects.
